details: CONFIRMED by a probe test. `held = {branch, *ab}` takes ab from relay_inert.absorbed, which keeps only the riders that would
pass the mark step on their own (_passes) and skips a branch at the tip of ref. A train that holds a rider whose own check is
open > 0 or stale (the "rider's check is out of date, checked again on the train" flow of the judge base) is checked as a whole,
lands, and post() removes the rider through riders(), which has neither filter. The set of branches whose items must be closed
is the set the merge makes leave: every wt/* branch (not wt/queue-*) with its tip inside ref and not on the default branch,
the branch itself included. The brief's pass case 1 ("train holding a rider with its fix item taken and open: refused") is
therefore met only for absorbed riders.
failing_case: Master has x taken by wt/a. wt/a commits lib/a.py with a check of open 1 (so relay_inert.absorbed leaves it out); wt/train-1
merges wt/a (--no-ff) and commits lib/t.py with its own gate and an open-0 check of the whole train.
judge(main, "master", "wt/train-1") returns None (the merge lands); post() then names wt/a among riders() and removes it, so x
stays taken by a deleted branch. Same with wt/train-1 created at wt/a's tip (git branch wt/train-1 wt/a): absorbed skips a
branch at the tip of ref, judge returns None, riders() is ['wt/a'].
Should: refused, "queue item x is taken by wt/a and still open: close it first, relay queue done x -C <wt/a worktree> ...".
fix_hint: Build held from every wt/* branch (not wt/queue-*) whose tip is an ancestor of ref and not of the default branch, plus branch
(the candidate set absorbed() computes before its _passes filter, or riders() minus branches already on the default branch).
Add the two probe cases as tests in ATrainLeavesNoTakenFixItem.
pass_cases: 1. The failing case above (rider wt/a not absorbed, train checked as a whole, x taken by wt/a): judge raises Refused naming

4. A stale wt/old branch already contained in master, holding a taken x, and a train that does not hold it: judge returns None
(a branch already on the default branch is not this merge's rider).
5. Branch wt/c with no item while x is taken by another branch: judge returns None.
